reviews.title: Amazing card for the price
reviews.comment: With the way GPU prices are nowadays this is a great idea to get a rebuilt item. I came from a 1060 that I had overclocked and was running everything great. After a little tweaking just performs closer to the 70 series. And since it was refurbished everything is nice and clean. All the pads have been redone, everything has been alcohol and cleaned. There are a few little scratches here and there but only minor, nothing that stops the card from working perfectly fine.
reviews.author: erron dunson

reviews.title: Great quality for a refurbished card
reviews.comment: Works great and was an awesome value. My card came almost looking brand new, and the graphics quality and speed are exactly what I wanted when I looked into buying a 4060.
